gates.name: Proof-only scoring contract
gates.evidence: Six Cairo PIE proof-stage timers are retained, but wrap, fold, and pipeline proof-only timers are not. The implemented h200-v1 judge scores adapted-input-to-publication time. A reviewed new epoch, complete timers, and fresh baselines are required before a proof-only leaderboard can launch.

gates.name: Contract and data
gates.evidence: All 60 public files hash-verified on a healthy H200; contract CI passes.

gates.name: Independent verifiers
gates.evidence: Both pinned Rust verifiers accepted every Cairo proof in two direct H200 rounds.

gates.name: Public proofs and folds
gates.evidence: Six PIEs, both folds and both pipeline modes reproduced exact reference hashes on H200.

gates.name: Private holdout
gates.evidence: An 18-case holdout passes hash preflight locally; not yet mounted on a judge.

gates.name: Paired scoring
gates.evidence: Tracks, guards, ABBA, A/A and bootstrap pass scorer tests; no paired H200 rounds yet.

gates.name: Intake and dispatch
gates.evidence: Intake, trusted builder, tiered receipts and signing pass locally; no self-hosted runner is configured.

gates.name: Candidate isolation
gates.evidence: CPU sandbox probe passed; GPU isolation on the actual H200 runner is still to qualify.
